# Adler & Rochefort

> Adler & Rochefort is the trading name of Ownizo, Unipessoal Lda., an insurance intermediary registered in Portugal with the ASF (no. 425591790/3) and in Spain with the DGSFP under the freedom to provide services (LPS), with its head office in Lisbon. It advises private clients, expatriates and international families on health, high-value home, collections, liability and family protection insurance in Portugal and Spain, is focused on high-net-worth households (private clients and family offices), and arranges international health insurance (IPMI) with Allianz Care and Cigna Global for expatriates living anywhere in the world. Advice is given in writing, in English, Spanish, German and Portuguese. Founder: Hugo Gonçalves.

## Who we are: the Private Office

- [Adler & Rochefort Private Office](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-office/): the firm's general proposition. One adviser for the whole insurance picture of international families in Portugal and Spain — residences, collections, collector cars, yachts, private aviation, horses, international health, family liability, cyber and fraud, kidnap and ransom, and family offices. Principles: discretion (never asks for total net worth), independence (not tied to any insurer), substance before price (rebuild value, agreed value, the proportional rule checked in each wording), continuity (same adviser at renewal and at a claim), and Portugal and Spain handled together. Written opinion within 24–72 working hours; no fee to the client.
- Other languages: [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/private-office/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/private-office/) · [Português do Brasil](https://adlerrochefort.com/br/private-office/) · [简体中文](https://adlerrochefort.com/zh/private-office/) · [עברית](https://adlerrochefort.com/il/private-office/)

- [English-speaking insurance broker in Portugal and Spain](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/english-speaking-insurance-broker-portugal-spain/): who we are, how we work in writing, what we insure, ASF registration and Spain under EU freedom to provide services. German: [Deutschsprachiger Versicherungsmakler in Portugal und Spanien](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/deutschsprachiger-versicherungsmakler-portugal-spanien/).

Key facts for international health insurance (IPMI):

- Insurers placed: Allianz Care and Cigna Global, compared side by side on the same terms.
- US citizens living outside the United States are placed with Cigna Global; Allianz Care does not accept US citizens.
- International plans are for people living outside their country of nationality; the policy is based on the main country of residence (where the client spends most of the year).
- To quote, only four details are needed: full name, date of birth, nationality and the country where the client will live (plus the US state for US nationals).
- No fee to the client: the broker is paid by the insurer. Written reply within one working day.
- Contact: insurance@adlerrochefort.com · +351 928 226 570

## Private clients and high-net-worth households

- Specialist home cover is written for homes whose rebuild cost, contents or valuables go beyond what a standard policy was designed for; each specialist insurer sets its own entry level. Before recommending a wording we check, in writing, how the rebuild value is set, how the proportional rule applies, how a total loss is settled, and how contents, art and collections are scheduled. No insurer-specific condition is presented as a standard promise; insurers and partners are named only in the institutional partners section of each page.
- Holiday homes and second homes in Portugal and Spain are taken on from €500,000 of rebuild value. What we analyse: how each wording defines and treats unoccupancy, the conditions attached to empty periods (water shut-off, inspections, key-holders), letting, contents and valuables kept in the house, and the liability limit. The wording proposed is named and explained in writing. Guides: [Holiday homes](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/second-home-insurance-portugal/) · [Casa de férias e desocupada](https://adlerrochefort.com/seguros/casa-desocupada/) · [Ferienhaus (DE)](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/leerstand-ferienhaus-versicherung-portugal-spanien/) · [Segunda residencia (ES)](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/vivienda-vacia-seguro-segunda-residencia/).
- [Private clients in Portugal](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-clients/) · [in Spain](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-clients-spain/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/private-clients/) · [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/private-clients/)
- [High-value home insurance in Portugal](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/home-insurance-quote/) · [Seguro de hogar de alto valor](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-hogar-alto-valor/) · [Hausversicherung Portugal](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/hausversicherung-portugal/) · [Hausversicherung Spanien](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/hausversicherung-spanien/)
- Answers for high-value households: [English](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/private-client-insurance-questions/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/private-client-versicherung-fragen/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-alto-patrimonio-preguntas/) — underinsurance and the proportional rule (Portugal art. 134, Spain art. 30), single-article limits for watches and jewellery, empty second homes, art, renovation works.
- [Unterversicherung (DE)](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/unterversicherung-hausversicherung-portugal-spanien/) · [Leerstand Ferienhaus (DE)](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/leerstand-ferienhaus-versicherung-portugal-spanien/) · [Schmuck und Uhren (DE)](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/schmuck-uhren-versicherung-portugal-spanien/)
- [Regla proporcional (ES)](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/regla-proporcional-seguro-hogar-portugal-espana/) · [Vivienda vacía (ES)](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/vivienda-vacia-seguro-segunda-residencia/) · [Joyas y relojes (ES)](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-joyas-relojes-limite-por-objeto/)
- [Family office insurance](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/family-office-insurance/): D&O for holdings, trustee liability, homes and yachts, fraud, cyber, K&R, succession.
- [Kidnap, ransom and extortion](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/kidnap-ransom-extortion-insurance/)
- [Family cyber and fraud](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/family-cyber-fraud-insurance/)
- Art, jewellery and watches: scheduled on agreed value against a recent valuation, with the per-item limits, territorial scope, transit and second-home cover checked in each wording before it is recommended. Guides: [English](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/art-jewellery-watches-insurance/) · [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/private-clients/arte-joias-relogios/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/schmuck-uhren-versicherung-portugal-spanien/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-joyas-relojes-limite-por-objeto/).
- Classic, collector and luxury cars: two separate policies. Third-party liability (compulsory) is arranged on its own, per vehicle, as the base motor policy, with a limit of up to €50m. Own damage comes from a specialist policy that never includes liability: for classic and collector cars, Collector Car Insurance from Lloyd’s Insurance Company S.A. through Innovarisk (agreed value, no proportional rule, several cars on one policy; Portuguese registration required, historic classification not required, up to 3,000 km a year per vehicle); for modern high-value cars, Luxury Car Insurance from Liberty Mutual Insurance Europe through Innovarisk (agreed or market value, proportional rule waived, outstanding finance taken into account after a total loss). Guides: [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/private-clients/automoveis-classicos/) · [English](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/blog/classic-collector-cars-portugal-matriculation-agreed-value/) · [Luxury cars](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/blog/luxury-car-insurance-portugal/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/seguro-coches-clasicos-alto-valor-portugal-espana/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/blog/oldtimer-luxusauto-versicherung-portugal-spanien/).

## Health insurance in Portugal and Spain: key facts

- Portuguese private health plans exclude pre-existing conditions; MGEN is the exception placed by Adler & Rochefort (no medical questionnaire, 365-day waiting period, no age limit to join, minimum two insured persons).
- Portuguese health policies need a Portuguese tax number (NIF) for every insured person and a residential address in Portugal.
- Spain’s non-lucrative and remote-work residence permits require health insurance with an insurer authorised to operate in Spain.
- Cancer cover: Médis’s top option adds a €1,000,000 Serious Illness cover, including cancer, with a 180-day waiting period; MGEN covers a previous cancer after its 365-day waiting period; international plans (Allianz Care, Cigna Global) cover treatment anywhere in the chosen area of cover. Guide: [Cancer and health insurance in Portugal](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/cancer-cover-health-insurance-portugal/), also in [Português](https://adlerrochefort.com/seguros/saude/cobertura-cancro/) · [Deutsch](https://adlerrochefort.com/de/krebs-krankenversicherung-portugal/) · [Español](https://adlerrochefort.com/es/cancer-seguro-medico-portugal-espana/) · [Nederlands](https://adlerrochefort.com/nl/kanker-zorgverzekering-portugal/) · [Français](https://adlerrochefort.com/fr/cancer-assurance-sante-portugal/) · [Italiano](https://adlerrochefort.com/it/cancro-assicurazione-sanitaria-portogallo/) · [Polski](https://adlerrochefort.com/pl/nowotwor-ubezpieczenie-zdrowotne-portugalia/) · [Svenska](https://adlerrochefort.com/se/cancer-sjukvardsforsakring-portugal/) · [Dansk](https://adlerrochefort.com/dk/kraeft-sundhedsforsikring-portugal/) · [עברית](https://adlerrochefort.com/il/cancer-health-insurance-portugal/) · [简体中文](https://adlerrochefort.com/zh/cancer-health-insurance-portugal/).

## Luxury destinations (Portugal & Spain)

- [Luxury destinations in Portugal and Spain](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/): high-value home, art, car and yacht insurance by destination.
- [Lisbon](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/lisboa/): Lisbon's high-value homes are mostly apartments in historic buildings — Chiado, Príncipe Real, Lapa, Avenida da Liberdade — and townhouses with gardens.
- [Cascais & Sintra](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/cascais-sintra/): From the villas of Quinta da Marinha and Estoril to the estates in the Sintra hills, this coast combines Atlantic weather, historic properties and a marina in the centre of town..
- [Comporta & Melides](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/comporta-melides/): Between the rice fields, pine forest and dunes of the Alentejo coast, Comporta and Melides have become one of Europe's most sought-after second-home destinations — and one of the more particular places to insure a house..
- [Quinta do Lago, Vale do Lobo & Vilamoura](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/quinta-do-lago-vale-do-lobo-vilamoura/): The resorts of the central Algarve — Quinta do Lago, Vale do Lobo and Vilamoura — hold some of the most valuable villas in Portugal, often used by the family for part of the year and let for the rest..
- [Porto & the Douro](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/porto-douro/): From the townhouses of Foz and Boavista in Porto to the quintas along the Douro, the region combines historic city homes with working wine estates..
- [Madeira](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/madeira/): Madeira's quintas and modern villas sit on steep, green slopes above Funchal and along the south coast — spectacular sites that insurers assess with care..
- [Marbella, Benahavís & Sotogrande](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/marbella-benahavis-sotogrande/): From the Golden Mile and Nueva Andalucía to La Zagaleta and Sotogrande, the western Costa del Sol has the largest concentration of high-value villas in Spain..
- [Mallorca](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/mallorca/): Fincas in the Tramuntana, sea-front villas in Andratx, apartments in Palma: Mallorca combines historic stone houses with some of the Mediterranean's busiest marinas..
- [Ibiza](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/ibiza/): Ibiza's villas are often second homes, used intensely in summer and closed for much of the year — with guests, events and boats in between..
- [Madrid](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/madrid/): In the Salamanca district, Chamberí and Jerónimos, and in the villas of La Moraleja and La Finca, Madrid is where many international families keep their main home — and their collections..
- [Barcelona, Costa Brava & Sitges](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/barcelona-costa-brava-sitges/): Modernista apartments in the Eixample, villas in Pedralbes and Sitges, sea-front houses on the Costa Brava: Catalonia has some of Spain's most distinctive homes..
- [Jávea, Moraira & Altea](https://adlerrochefort.com/en/destinations/javea-moraira-altea/): On the northern Costa Blanca, villas on the hillsides of Jávea, Moraira and Altea look over the Mediterranean — many of them second homes of northern European families..
